newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish electric gauge maker Apator IPO cleared.
newsitem.headline: Polish electric gauge maker Apator IPO cleared.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) cleared an initial public offering of 800,000 shares of electric gauge maker Apator Torun SA and cleared for public trade an existing two million shares, the KPW said.
The president of the Apator Torun, Janusz Marzyglinski, said the company, which is seeking a main market listing, would offer the new shares on subscription between January 27-31.
Marzyglinski also said the company's shareholders, mainly employees, would offer about 600,0000 existing shares on subscription.

Apator, based in Torun, northern Poland, employs 1,150 and expects net profit of four million zlotys this year on sales of 74 million zlotys, compared with last year's 4.5-million-zloty net on sales of 67.1 million zlotys.
